payload.question: For students of the top course in S1 show their mean across all S1 courses

descriptor.policy: Equal graded enrollments, NULL excluded, all offerings/retakes. Absent filters mean all including semesters. Mean projections COALESCE(SUM(e.grade_units),0) AS sum_units, COUNT(e.grade_units) AS graded_count, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count. Base Enrollments e JOIN Offerings o ON e.offering_id=o.offering_id. Optional equality predicates named student_id/course_id/teacher_id/semester_id; group keys e.student_id or o.course_id/teacher_id/offering_id/semester_id. For rows GROUP BY key ORDER BY key. Top returns ALL course components, adapter selects exact maximum ties. student_ids uses SELECT DISTINCT e.student_id ORDER BY e.student_id. Dependency course_ids/student_ids bind named <ref>_0,<ref>_1 etc in IN clause. Empty ref WHERE 0=1. Listing adds Students s,Courses c,Teachers t joins on IDs and ordered declared projections; ORDER BY e.offering_id,e.student_id.

sql_proposals.sql: SELECT o.course_id AS course_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.grade_units),0) AS sum_units, COUNT(e.grade_units) AS graded_count, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count FROM Enrollments e JOIN Offerings o ON e.offering_id = o.offering_id WHERE o.semester_id = :semester_id GROUP BY o.course_id ORDER BY o.course_id

SELECT DISTINCT e.student_id AS student_id FROM Enrollments e JOIN Offerings o ON e.offering_id = o.offering_id WHERE o.semester_id = :semester_id AND o.course_id IN (:course_ids_0,:course_ids_1) ORDER BY e.student_id

SELECT e.student_id AS student_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.grade_units),0) AS sum_units, COUNT(e.grade_units) AS graded_count, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count FROM Enrollments e JOIN Offerings o ON e.offering_id = o.offering_id WHERE o.semester_id = :semester_id AND e.student_id IN (:student_ids_0,:student_ids_1,:student_ids_2) GROUP BY e.student_id ORDER BY e.student_id
